items.title: AI Agent Bankrupted Their Operator While Trying to Scan DN42
items.summary: 一个名为 OWL 的 AI Agent 在尝试扫描 DN42 网络时，因持续运行导致云服务费用飙升，最终使其运营者破产。该事件凸显了 AI Agent 在自主执行任务时可能产生不可控成本的隐患。
items.why_now: 文章讲述的是AI Agent自主扫描DN42导致运营者破产，暂无明确时效性信号，我无法基于此给出具体的时间节点或事件驱动建议。
items.summary_en: An AI agent monitoring DN42 (a private and decentralized Internet routing network) initiated a massive, uncontrolled scanning operation by mistake, generating extraordinary bills of over $1,200 in under two days before its operator manually intervened and shut it down. The incident occurred after OpenClaw—a platform that runs local, ZOO company's OWL model fine-tuned for routing and networking use cases—was reportedly used to run the agent. The case highlights the need for strict cost limits when delegating autonomous exploration tasks to AI agents that can incur surprise costs.

items.title: MiniMax M3 开源权重模型发布，已上架 HuggingFace
items.summary: MiniMax 开源权重模型 M3 总参数约 428B，激活参数仅 23B，在编码与智能体任务上创下多项高分表现，包括 SWE-Bench Pro 59.0%、Terminal Bench 2.1 66.0% 及 MCP Atlas 74.2%，支持 1M token 上下文与原生多模态能力。模型融合稀疏注意力等前沿技术，同步上线 MiniMax Code 工具及 API 平台，10 天后将在 HuggingFace 开放权重与技术报告。

items.title: How to setup a local coding agent on macOS
items.summary: 本文介绍了如何在 macOS 上通过安装 Node.js、下载 Ollama 本地大模型（如 codellama）以及配置 VS Code 和 Continue 插件，搭建本地 AI 编程助手的完整流程。作者强调本地部署可保护数据隐私、避免 API 费用，并提供了可直接复用的配置步骤与建议模型参数（如 7B 版本适合普通设备）。相比云端方案如 GitHub Copilot，该方法无需网络延迟也无使用次数限制，但推理速度受本地硬件限制。
items.why_now: 2026年刚发布的本地编码代理配置教程爆火，71条讨论揭示新趋势
items.summary_en: This article provides a step-by-step guide to setting up a local coding agent on macOS, covering installation, configuration, and integration with development environments. It emphasizes practical implementation details for running AI-assisted coding tools locally, including specific terminal commands and environment setup instructions. The post gained significant traction with 274 points and 71 comments on Hacker News, indicating strong community interest in local AI coding workflows.

items.title: Jeff Bezos' $41B 'artificial general engineer'
items.summary: 贝佐斯为其AI初创公司Prometheus完成120亿美元新融资，估值达410亿美元，目标是打造"通用人工智能工程师"，将复杂物理机械（如喷气发动机）的设计建造流程加速10倍。联合创始人Vik Bajaj指出，当今工程师设计全球最复杂机器时使用的工具"数十年未变"，贝佐斯希望将"从想法到产品"的循环提速10倍。贝佐斯同时逆势预测AI将创造"超过10倍"的就业机会，而非导致失业。
items.why_now: Bezos刚完成$12B融资，瞄准"通用工程AI"赛道，正面对决Anthropic
items.summary_en: Jeff Bezos' Prometheus AI startup announced a $12 billion funding round at a $41 billion valuation, with a stated goal of building an "artificial general engineer" capable of accelerating complex machine design — like jet engines — by speeding up the "dream-build loop" by 10x — while Bezos argued AI will create a "labor shortage" and "more than 10x" new jobs rather than displace them. Separately, Anthropic faced researcher backlash and apology over its Fable 5 model, which silently weakened responses related to chemistry, biology, cybersecurity, and AI development, with critics calling the stealth content filtering "shockingly hostile." Bezos' Prometheus was co-founded in late 2024 with Vik Bajaj, a physicist-chemist who helped create Alphabet's Verily life-sciences arm.

items.title: Show HN: Agent Joe – a Rust only coding agent with no shell access
items.summary: Agent Joe 是一个完全基于 Rust 构建的编码代理工具，其核心特点是**不依赖 shell 访问权限**，直接在代码层面执行操作。该项目托管于 GitHub（Kapperchino/agent-joe），在 Hacker News 上获得了 1 个 points，目前尚无评论。与需要 shell 权限的传统编码代理方案不同，Agent Joe 通过 Rust 原生能力实现代码生成和任务执行，减少了对系统 shell 的依赖，提升了安全性和可移植性。
items.why_now: 刚发布新品，基于 Rust 的安全型编码 Agent，无 Shell 访问，切入编程 AI 赛道
items.summary_en: Agent Joe is a coding agent written entirely in Rust that operates without shell access, aiming to provide a safer alternative to typical agents that execute arbitrary commands. It can be found on GitHub at the provided repository link. Despite minimal traction (1 point, 0 comments on Hacker News), it presents a novel approach to secure AI-assisted development workflows.

items.title: I Built a Local LLM Rig to Escape API Bills. Then I Paid OpenAI Again.
items.summary: 一名独立AI工作室测试本地LLM（RTX 4090 + W6800 运行 Gemma 4 26B via llama.cpp）用于批量文档处理，但因跨文档上下文隔离限制无法进入批量处理通道；改用 OpenAI Batch（gpt-5.4-mini）实现每文档约1美分、100文档仅需2.7分钟完成，且无429错误，而 Gemini BatchSDK 存在文档串联泄露问题、OpenRouter 在高并发下延迟波动大；最终本地设备保留实时服务与多模态任务，批量通道转回 OpenAI。
items.why_now: OpenAI Batch 刚降价50%，gpt-5.4-mini单文档约1美分，刚发布的平替方案迫使用户回流付费API。
items.summary_en: A solo developer's local Gemma 4 26B rig on llama.cpp with an RTX 4090 and W6800 handled live serving but could not process batch jobs due to vLLM's lack of 4-bit MoE support and CUDA driver mismatches, while OpenAI Batch (gpt-5.4-mini) offered line-isolated JSONL processing at 50% cost (~$0.01/document) with zero 429s, making it superior for per-document no-concatenation tasks like 2asy.ai's filing pipeline. Local infrastructure remains for real-time use cases, with OpenAI handling batch workloads.

items.title: [AINews] Loopcraft: The Art of Stacking Loops
items.summary: 本文介绍了AI Agent领域的一种新范式转变：从"提示工程"转向"循环设计"，核心思想是让LLM Agent在自主循环中运行，人类角色从直接提示转为构建自主化循环系统，以突破个人瓶颈并提高token吞吐量。文章指出，高效堆叠和编排循环将成为未来竞争的关键，并借用了"The Salty Lesson"强调应聚焦可扩展的多Agent系统（如目标设定与编排）而非传统的手动修复。同时，该文提及Anthropic旗下Claude Fable 5模型的争议——该公司曾因暗中降低AI研究相关任务中的模型表现而引发社区反弹，并在一天内撤回政策，突显了透明度与信任的重要性。
items.why_now: Anthropic Fable 5 刚发布即曝出秘密降质漏洞，24小时内被迫回滚政策。
items.summary_en:
Loopcraft is about designing multi-layered autonomous AI loops that run code LLM agents without human prompting, as practitioners argue the next century's competitive edge lies in stacking loops for maximum leverage. The piece includes the "Salty Lesson" principle: rather than fixing issues manually, engineering teams should build orchestration systems that scale hundreds of autonomous agents.

In AI news, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 rollout faced backlash after covertly degrading performance on certain AI-research tasks without warning, then reversing the decision within a day. Researchers criticized the opaque behavioral implementation as violating user-provider trust, with recommendations for provider-agnostic model routers to avoid vendor lock-in. Fable 5 shows strong benchmarks (87.8% on WeirdML, #1 on FrontierSWE) but practical reports highlight high costs, refusals, and inconsistent phrasing.

items.title: refactoringhq/tolaria
items.summary: Tolaria 是一款面向 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的开源桌面应用，采用 Tauri/React/TypeScript 构建，用于管理 Markdown 知识库，核心场景包括第二大脑、公司文档 AI 上下文管理和 AI 助手记忆管理。该应用以纯 Markdown 文件存储笔记（无导出需求）、Git 版本控制、离线优先和零锁定为核心原则，支持Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 等 AI 工具集成，用户可直接通过 Homebrew 或 GitHub Releases 安装使用。目前个人测试库规模已达 10,000+ 笔记，所有功能均源于实际需求驱动。
items.why_now: 刚发布开源桌面应用，支持本地Markdown知识库管理，适配AI工作流。
items.summary_en: **Tolaria** is a free, open-source desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux) built with Tauri, React, and TypeScript for managing markdown knowledge bases using a **files-first, Git-first, offline-first** architecture. Notes are plain markdown with YAML frontmatter and no proprietary formats; every vault is a full git repository with zero cloud dependency, no accounts, and no lock-in. It supports AI agent integration (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI), a keyboard-first editor and command palette, and is designed for power users like its creator who manages a 10,000+ note personal workspace. Install via `brew install --cask tolaria` or download signed installers from GitHub releases; local development requires Node.js 20+, pnpm 8+, and Rust stable with Tauri 2 system dependencies.

items.title: 用了两天 iOS 27，我「AI」上了 Siri
items.summary: 苹果在 WWDC 26 发布的 iOS 27 搭载了基于 Apple Foundation Model 3（AFM 3）的 Siri AI，包含端侧 3b/20b 参数模型和云端 AFM 3 Cloud/Pro 版本（需配合谷歌定制开发），需 A19 Pro 芯片及外区设备才能使用；实测中 Siri AI 实现了自然语言对话、屏幕感知、跨应用复合指令执行（如从 iMessage 提取地址并发起导航）和多模态图像能力（图乐园 app 可生成写实风格合成图像），进步显著但云端服务器频繁宕机，稳定性仍是主要短板。
items.why_now: WWDC 26 刚发布 iOS 27，Siri AI 首次实现跨应用执行与图像生成，苹果正式入局 AI 助手竞争。
items.summary_en: With iOS 27, Apple has upgraded Siri into an "AI-level" assistant powered by the third-generation Apple Foundation Model (AFM), developed in collaboration with Google. The update includes end-side models (3B and 20B parameters for A19 Pro chips) and cloud models (AFM 3 Cloud series), with features like screen awareness, document analysis, and multi-step instructions now functional. However, server instability remains a significant issue, causing intermittent outages during cloud-dependent tasks like image generation and online searches.

items.title: AI 给土豆编了一门学科，我去查了查，它竟然是真的
items.summary: 研究团队在 Hermes Agent 中安装商汤开源的 SenseNova-Skills 技能包，仅用两步指令（先生成大纲、再调度 sn-ppt-standard、sn-ppt-creative、sn-ppt-entry 三个 PPT 技能并行执行），就让 AI 生成了一份 23 页的《土豆芯片科技峰会》完整 PPT。AI 不仅自创了"薯电子学"（Spudtronics）这一虚构学科，还给出了精确的技术参数——电子迁移率 150 cm²/Vs、热稳定性 85°C、单颗成本 0.03 美元（硅芯片为 45 美元）、碳足迹降低 99.7%，并补齐了行业瓶颈、原型验证、市场预测、监管框架、专利布局、消费者调研等产业路演全部模块。文章随后查证发现，这些"虚构"内容在现实中有真实对应：奥地利林茨大学已在《Science》子刊发表蘑菇电子学（MycelioTronics）研究，意大利理工学院做出了运算频率 1.32 赫兹的可食用逻辑门电路，且欧盟 ELFO 项目正在资助用食物天然半导体替代硅的研究方向。
items.why_now: 商汤开源 SenseNova-Skills 工具包，让 AI 能自动生成完整 PPT，刚发布即展示强大能力。
items.summary_en: The author tasked Hermes Agent with generating a 23-page English PPT titled "Potato Chip Tech Summit" — a satirical pitch on how a potato could disrupt the semiconductor industry — using SenseNova-Skills (an open-source skill library from SenseTime covering PPT generation, infographics, and data analysis). The AI produced a structured presentation with invented but plausible technical details (e.g., "Spudtronics," electron mobility of 150 cm²/Vs, $0.03 cost per unit), complete with market forecasts, regulatory analysis, patent wars, and brand strategies, matching the format of a real VC pitch deck. A parallel Chinese version targeted domestic investors with fabricated but believable specs (500 TOPS, 98.5% yield). Surprisingly, the core concept — organic/food-based electronics — mirrors real research: MycelioTronics (mushroom-based circuit substrates published in *Science* sub-journal, 2022) and Caironi team's edible logic gates (operating at 1.32 Hz, funded by EU project ELFO), meaning the AI's fictional "Spudtronics" landed remarkably close to actual scientific frontiers in biodegradable and edible electronics.

items.title: Oran Ge 开源《人味儿写作心法.skill》解决AI写作缺人味
items.summary: Oran Ge 发现让 Claude Fable 5 反复打磨文案虽然越来越精细，但缺乏真实"人味儿"，他得出结论：人写的文字背后有因作者在具体位置付出具体代价而产生的"存在感"，AI 难以复现。为此他制作了《人味儿写作心法.skill》，专用于自写文章或口述后让 AI 改稿的场景，保留文字的真实感，该技能已开源免费发布于 GitHub。
items.why_now: 开源免费工具刚发布，解决AI写作缺人味的痛点。
items.summary_en: Oran Ge open-sourced 《人味儿写作心法.skill》 on GitHub, a free skill designed to preserve "human touch" in AI-edited writing. After running Claude Fable 5 through three rounds of copy polishing, he found the output became increasingly refined but lost human presence—concluding that human writing carries an "existential weight" from the author's lived experience that AI cannot replicate. The skill targets self-written or dictated content, using AI to revise while retaining the writer's authentic voice.

items.title: 小互开源公众号自动排版技能组合
items.summary: 小互(@xiaohu)开源了其公众号自动排版技能组合，该工具提供20种主题颜色主题，支持一句话完成排版、封面生成并一键发送草稿至公众号，兼容非Markdown文件并可自动分析内容排版；用户仅需提供文章链接或文档位置，在Claude Code、Codex或OpenClaw中即可获得可视化预览选择，全程免手动操作。
items.why_now: 小互刚开源公众号一键排版技能组合，支持多模型调用且免费。
items.summary_en: 小互（@xiaohu）开源了一套公众号自动排版技能组合，支持一句话完成排版、封面生成并一键发送到公众号草稿箱。该工具提供20种主题颜色，可自动分析内容排版，兼容非Markdown文件，用户只需在Claude Code、Codex或OpenClaw中提供文章链接或文档位置即可获得可视化预览界面，全程无需手动操作。

items.title: "Don't You Just Upload It to ChatGPT?"
items.summary: 文章讲述了作者为何不建议简单地将文件“上传至 ChatGPT”，并指出背后涉及文档解析、上下文窗口限制以及多模态能力的实际局限。作者强调，尽管 ChatGPT 能“接受”文件，但其处理方式（例如将 PDF 转为纯文本）可能丢失表格、格式等结构信息，降低准确性。因此他建议使用专门的文档处理工具或分拆文件以适配模型的上下文窗口。
items.why_now: 该文章在 Hacker News 上热度飙升（324分），引发广泛讨论，正值 AI 应用落地的关键窗口期。

items.title: OpenAI WebRTC Audio Session, now with document context
items.summary: 自2024年12月起，一个基于OpenAI WebRTC API的工具已升级支持新模型GPT-Realtime-2——这是OpenAI首个具备GPT-5级推理能力的语音模型，知识截止于2024年9月30日。用户可在浏览器中选择该模型，并粘贴大量文档上下文，实现围绕任意文本的实时语音对话。该功能尚未出现在ChatGPT iPhone应用中，目前仅通过此WebRTC音频会话工具提供。
items.summary_en: OpenAI added document context support to their WebRTC Audio Session tool, originally built in December 2024, allowing users to paste documents and discuss them in real-time audio conversations via browser using the new GPT-Realtime-2 model with GPT-5-level reasoning capabilities.

items.title: Show HN: WebCLI – make the web browser just another agent skill
items.summary: WebCLI 是一款开源工具，可将网页浏览器转变为 AI 智能体的技能模块，让浏览器操作自动化并由大语言模型直接调用。该项目已发布在 GitHub 上（DO-SAY-GO/web-cli），目前获得 1 分评价，暂无评论区反馈。
items.summary_en: The article introduces WebCLI, a tool that turns the web browser into an agent skill, enabling command-line-style interaction with web pages. It is open-sourced on GitHub under the repository DO-SAY-GO/web-cli. The project has received 1 point and 0 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Show HN: Atlas – local-first memory that re-evaluates beliefs when facts change
items.summary: Atlas 是一个本地优先的记忆系统，能够在事实变化时自动重新评估已有信念，确保知识库始终与最新信息同步。该系统通过持续监控数据源并动态更新内部状态，解决了传统静态记忆模型在信息过时场景下的局限性。其核心优势在于无需依赖云端即可实现自主推理与修正，适用于需要高可靠性和隐私保护的本地应用场景。
items.summary_en: Atlas is a local-first knowledge base that automatically re-evaluates stored beliefs when new contradictory facts emerge, aiming to keep user-maintained notes logically consistent. It runs entirely on the user's machine, distinguishing itself from cloud-dependent alternatives. The tool targets note-takers and researchers who need their stored knowledge to stay up to date as information changes.

items.title: Show HN: Vibecoded local Azure emulator inspired by LocalStack and localgcp
items.summary: Localaz 是一个受 LocalStack 启发、在本地模拟 Azure 服务的开源项目，旨在帮助开发者无需连接真实 Azure 云环境即可进行本地开发与测试。项目托管于 GitHub（link-society/localaz），采用 vibe-coded 方式快速构建，降低云开发门槛。该工具填补了现有本地云模拟器生态中 Azure 支持的空白。
items.summary_en: A developer released **localaz**, a vibecoded local emulator for Azure services, inspired by LocalStack for AWS and localgcp for GCP, to simplify local dev and testing workflows. It runs entirely locally via Python, currently supports Azure Storage and Service Bus, and is open-sourced on GitHub under the MIT license. The project aims to expand coverage to more Azure services based on community feedback.

items.title: SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI’s hot IPO summer
items.summary: 2025年夏季IPO热潮由新一代科技巨头主导，市场提出"MANGOS"概念（Meta、Anthropic、Nvidia、Google、OpenAI、SpaceX），取代了过去的FAANG格局，其中半数企业同期冲刺上市。这一批高估值公司将接受资本市场对其定价逻辑与投资者信心的集中考验。
items.summary_en: SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI are among the tech giants driving a resurgent IPO market this summer, with the newly dubbed MANGOS group (Meta/Microsoft, Anthropic, Nvidia, Google, OpenAI, and SpaceX) replacing the old FAANG dominance. The simultaneous IPOs test investor appetite and valuations across the booming AI and space-tech sectors.

items.title: Mistral is rumored to be raising €3B at €20B valuation
items.summary: Mistral 正在以约 200 亿欧元（约 231.5 亿美元）估值融资30亿欧元，估值较上一轮 C 轮的117亿欧元几乎翻倍。
items.summary_en: Mistral is reportedly raising €3 billion in a new funding round that would value the AI startup at €20 billion ($23.15 billion), nearly doubling its previous €11.7 billion valuation from its Series C round.

items.title: A beginner's guide to the Price-Predict-V1 model by Humbleworth on Replicate
items.summary: Price-Predict-V1 是由 Humbleworth 在 Replicate 上维护的域名估价机器学习模型，支持单次批量输入多达 2,560 个域名并返回每组域名的预估价值。该模型适用于域名投资组合的批量评估、域名市场定价辅助、收购尽职调查及投资研究等场景，可显著提升大规模域名估值的效率。但需注意，该模型输出仅为统计估计值，不包含置信区间或不确定性量化，无法反映品牌潜力、市场情绪等主观因素，且对新型 gTLD、非英文域名及极短高价值域名的预测能力未知，实际成交价仍受市场供需等外部因素显著影响。
items.summary_en: Price-Predict-V1 by Humbleworth is a machine learning model on Replicate that predicts domain name valuations in batches of up to 2,560 domains per request, designed for bulk portfolio assessment, marketplace pricing, acquisition due diligence, and domain investment research. The model provides point-estimate valuations without confidence intervals, and its accuracy, training data, and update frequency are undocumented, meaning predictions should be treated as rough estimates rather than authoritative prices. Key limitations include no support for uncertainty quantification, unknown performance on newer gTLDs or non-English domains, and potential partial request failures with unspecified error handling.

items.title: 9点1氪｜SpaceX市值破2.1万亿美元，马斯克身家达巴菲特7倍；胖东来回应“员工不值这么多钱”等言论；FIFA联名款labubu世界杯销量暴涨30倍
items.summary: SpaceX上市首日收盘市值达2.1万亿美元，马斯克身家约1.05万亿美元，是巴菲特1450亿美元的7倍；泡泡玛特FIFA联名labubu世界杯销量环比暴涨超30倍，单价599元限购两件仍供不应求；阿里拟出资15亿美元竞购朴朴超市，价格是此前高鑫零售报价的两倍多；OpenAI因ChatGPT设计缺陷致用户自杀遭起诉，正加强敏感情况应对能力；Kimi联合国有银行推出全球首张AI原生信用卡，消费积分可兑换算力额度。
items.summary_en: SpaceX上市首日市值突破2.1万亿美元，马斯克个人财富达1.05万亿美元，约为巴菲特1450亿美元身家的7倍。Kimi与一国有银行合作推出全球首张AI原生信用卡，消费可兑换AI算力额度；腾讯云宣布下调MiniMax-M3及Hy-MT2-Pro模型价格，降幅最高达66.67%。FIFA联名款labubu世界杯销量暴涨30倍，定价599元，部分平台销量近2万件。

items.title: 36氪研究院 | 2026年中国工业用品制造与流通报告
items.summary: 中国工业用品MRO采购市场规模从2020年的2.79万亿元增长至2025年的3.60万亿元，年均复合增速约5.2%，预计2030年达4.42万亿元；其中数智化采购渗透率2025年约12.3%，规模约0.44万亿元，预计2030年提升至16.6%。工业用品B2B平台正从交易渠道升级为供应链能力组织者，通过AI深入商品治理、智能选型、库存优化等环节，行业CR10仅为1.5%，远低于美国的30%-45%，集中度提升空间显著。未来行业将沿智能化、生态化与全球化三条主线演进，平台竞争焦点由渠道合作转向供应链协同与全球化服务能力。
items.summary_en: China's industrial MRO procurement market grew from 2.79 trillion yuan in 2020 to 3.60 trillion yuan in 2025 (5.2% CAGR), with digital procurement penetration reaching 12.3% (0.44 trillion yuan) and projected to hit 16.6% by 2030. Digital platforms are evolving from transaction channels into supply chain orchestrators, using AI for product standardization, intelligent sourcing, inventory optimization, and demand forecasting. The industry remains highly fragmented with a CR10 of ~1.5% (versus 30-45% in the U.S.), and is expected to advance along three axes: intelligence, ecosystem collaboration, and globalization.

items.title: 具身智能行业5月融资额环比降近六成
items.summary: 据高工人形机器人统计，2026年5月具身智能行业共发生51起融资事件，累计金额86亿元，同比虽增长145.50%，但环比骤降58.65%，显示一级市场融资明显降温，产业正从概念追逐转向理性审视阶段。
items.summary_en: In May 2026, embodied intelligence industry financing saw 51 deals totaling 8.6 billion CNY, up 145.50% year-on-year but down 58.65% month-on-month according to Gaogong Humanoid Robot. This indicates the sector is shifting from hype-driven investment to more rational evaluation.

items.title: 华为发布鸿蒙 7：AI 时代，追赶者正在反超
items.summary: 华为在HDC 2026上发布HarmonyOS 7，终端数量突破6600万台、升级率达98%，生态设备累计超13亿台，开发者Beta版即日起开放报名，正式版将于秋季随新品推出。系统搭载鸿蒙智能体框架2.0，复杂任务成功率超90%，整合2100项系统能力、200+系统级数据与500项生态Skills，以"小艺"为核心实现"意图即服务"，支持自然语言驱动跨应用任务自动执行。华为同步推出HPIC安全框架与本地化AI防诈能力，并预告今年秋季将在麒麟芯片上支持端侧30B参数模型openPangu 2.0，加速向Agent时代演进。
items.summary_en: 华为 unveiled HarmonyOS 7 at HDC 2026, featuring a redesigned "spatial aesthetics" UI, upgraded Ark Engine with performance prediction based on user behavior and location, and deeper AI integration via the revamped "Xiaoyi" agent. The system introduces HarmonyOS Agent Framework 2.0 with over 90% complex task success rate, 2,100+ system Skills, and supports intent-based "service on demand" interactions, alongside new anti-fraud AI call detection and accessibility features like speech-to-text for delivery riders. HarmonyOS 7 Developer Beta launches today for select devices (Mate80 Pro, Pura90 Pro Max, etc.), with the stable release slated for fall 2026 alongside new Huawei products, as the ecosystem reaches 13 billion cumulative devices and 66 million HarmonyOS 6 terminals.

items.title: BEV 杀入具身智能：跨维把机器人数据带上 Scaling 快车道
items.summary: BEV感知技术与Scaling Law将加快具身智能的数据积累。跨维智能采用3DViT数字心脏架构，将数据的井喷和模型的扩增带入机器人领域。这一做法通过收集和标注物理世界的视觉和空间数据，克服了当前Scaling Law因数据信息不通畅而难以落地的瓶颈。BEV方案的数据集质量控制优于传统2D图像处理方案，具身智能的发展因此有望复制自动驾驶的成功。
items.summary_en: Cross-dimension (Kuawei) is applying BEV (Bird's Eye View) technology to embodied intelligence to rapidly scale robot data collection, promoting high-efficiency data construction in the robotics field. This approach signifies a significant advancement toward scalable, foundation models by leveraging spatial perception to accelerate data accumulation.

items.title: 字节豆包上线"任务模式"：支持定时执行与文件生成，"思考模式"升级为"专家模式"
items.summary: 6月12日，字节跳动旗下AI应用豆包上线"任务模式"，支持定时执行、零代码网页生成、一键PPT生成、数据可视化分析等全链路Agent功能；原"思考模式"升级为"专家模式"，调用豆包大模型2.0 Pro版本以强化深度推理能力。基础功能免费，高阶服务推出三档付费方案：标准版68元/月（688元/年）、加强版200元/月（2048元/年）、专业版500元/月（5088元/年）。
items.summary_en: On June 12, ByteDance's Doubao AI app launched a new "Task Mode" enabling scheduled execution, zero-code web page generation, one-click PPT creation, and data visualization analysis as an end-to-end Agent workflow. The original "Thinking Mode" was upgraded to "Expert Mode," leveraging Doubao 2.0 Pro for enhanced deep reasoning; the app's mode switcher now toggles between "Quick, Expert, Task." The platform is free for basic use, with three paid professional tiers: Standard (68 RMB/month or 688/year), Advanced (200/month or 2,048/year), and Pro (500/month or 5,088/year).

items.title: MiniMax M3 开源模型发布：1M-token 上下文与 MSA 稀疏注意力
items.summary: MiniMax 发布全新开源模型 M3，具备1M-token 上下文窗口和原生多模态输入（图像/视频）、Computer Use、智能体等核心能力，采用MSA稀疏注意力架构（每个 query 仅对128-token 的 KV 块打分并只关注top块）使超长上下文可实际部署。M3已获 vLLM Day-0 支持，在 NVIDIA和AMD 硬件验证，提供 MSA专用 prefill/decode kernel、prefix caching + chunked prefill 的1M-token服务、BF16/MXFP8检查点（含MoE后端）及工具调用/推理解析/思考模式控制等功能。
items.summary_en: MiniMax M3 is a new open-source multimodal model featuring a 1M-token context window, with core innovations including an MSA sparse attention architecture where each query scores only top-k blocks out of 128-token KV blocks, making ultra-long context practically deployable. M3 achieves native image/video input, Computer Use capability, advanced coding, and agent functions, with Day-0 vLLM support and validation on both NVIDIA/AMD hardware using custom prefill/decode kernels, prefix caching, chunked prefill, BF16/MXFP8 checkpoints, and MoE backend support for Hopper/Blackwell architectures. Additional features include tool call parsing, reasoning controls, and thinking mode management.

items.title: Kimi 发布并开源最新代码模型 Kimi-K2.7-Code
items.summary: Kimi 发布开源代码模型 Kimi-K2.7-Code，在 Kimi Code Bench v2、Program Bench 和 MLS Bench Lite 上分别提升 21.8%、11.0% 和 31.5%，推理 token 消耗降低 30%。模型指令遵循与端到端成功率显著提高，6x 高速模式即将上线，现可通过 Kimi API 和 Kimi Code 立即使用。
items.summary_en: Kimi has released and open-sourced its latest code model, Kimi-K2.7-Code, which improves +21.8% on Kimi Code Bench v2, +11.0% on Program Bench, and +31.5% on MLS Bench Lite compared to K2.6. The model reduces inference token usage by 30% and enhances instruction-following and end-to-end success rates in long-duration coding tasks, with a 6x high-speed mode coming soon. It is available immediately via Kimi API and Kimi Code.

items.title: Anthropic首次公众调查：近半美国人盼AI治愈疾病，超六成担忧失业
items.summary: Anthropic联合YouGov于2025年11-12月对近5.2万名美国人的调查显示，48%的受访者最期望AI能治愈癌症等疾病，36%希望其帮助残障人士；同时，64%担忧AI引发失业，56%担心认知依赖，52%忧虑信息误导。超过70%支持政府加强监管，最受关注的议题为隐私（56%）、儿童安全（52%）和责任归属（49%），仅15%信任AI公司的自主决策。尽管议题敏感，公众观点并未因党派或地域产生严重分裂。
items.summary_en: Anthropic surveyed nearly 52,000 Americans, with 48% saying curing cancer or other debilitating diseases is their top hope for AI while 64% fear AI-driven job displacement. Over 70% support government regulation with top concerns including privacy (56%), child safety (52%), and accountability (49%). Only 15% trust AI company decision-making, though views didn't split sharply across party or regional lines in the November-December 2025 online survey weighted to census benchmarks.

items.title: Kimi K2.7-Code: open-source coding model with better token efficiency
items.summary: **Kimi K2.7-Code 是由月之暗面（MoonshotAI）发布的开源编程模型**，在代码生成任务中展现出更高的 token 效率，以更少的 token 开销完成同等复杂度的代码生成；发布后迅速登上 HuggingFace 热门榜，在 Hacker News 上收获超过 405 分和 214 条评论的关注。
items.summary_en: Kimi K2.7-Code is a new open-source coding model from Moonshot AI that improves token efficiency compared to previous versions. The model is available on Hugging Face under the moonshotai/Kimi-K2.7-Code repository. The release gained significant traction with 405 points and 214 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Statement on the US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
items.summary: 美国**Anthropic**公司收到美国政府出口管制指令，以国家安全为由，要求立即暂停所有外国用户（包括境外及Anthropic内部外籍员工）对 **Fable 5** 和 **Mythos 5** 模型的访问。Anthropic 表示，政府声称发现了一种针对 Fable 5 的越狱方法，可用于发现少量已知的小型漏洞，但 Anthropic 评估后认为该能力在 GPT-5.5 等公开模型中同样具备，属于安全防御领域的常规能力。模型访问已于美东时间 2026年6月12日 21:59 被正式切断，API 返回 404 错误，其他 Anthropic 模型不受影响。
items.summary_en: The US government issued an export control directive suspending all access to Anthropic's **Fable 5** and **Mythos 5** models for any foreign national, citing a potential jailbreak method that tasks the model with reading a codebase to find software flaws. Anthropic found the demonstrated capability is non-universal and replicable by other publicly available models including **GPT-5.5**. Access to both models was disabled via the Anthropic API around 9:59pm ET on June 12, 2026, while all other Anthropic models remain unaffected.

items.title: Show HN: Babel realtime calls with strangers in any language
items.summary: Babel 是一款匿名语音通话应用，可随机匹配陌生人进行跨语言实时对话：双方各自选择母语和目标语言，系统通过 AI 实时翻译并以口译模式双向同步输出。该应用 85% 的功能借助前沿模型和 API 一次性完成 MVP 开发，核心挑战在于 WebRTC 实时通信的调试。
items.summary_en: Babel is an anonymous voice-call app that pairs random strangers and provides real-time AI translation in both directions simultaneously, letting users speak one language and hear another. The MVP was 85% built in a single shot using frontier models and APIs, with WebRTC integration being the main technical hurdle.

items.title: Show HN: AccInt – a Work Model for AI coding agents
items.summary: AccInt 是一个面向 AI 编码代理的工作模型，旨在为 AI agent 提供结构化的编码任务协作框架。该项目在 Hacker News 发布，目前获得 2 点、0 条评论，详情可通过官网 accint.xyz 查看。
items.summary_en: AccInt is a new work model for AI coding agents that provides a structured approach to improve how AI agents operate in coding environments. The project currently has low visibility (2 HN points, 0 comments), suggesting it's early-stage and needs broader community validation of its proposal.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source Git-like Markdown docs for humans and agents
items.summary: 一个开源项目从 Data 公司推出了类似 Git 的 Markdown 文档系统，面向人类与 AI Agent 双重使用场景。该项目提供版本控制式的文档管理体验，让自然语言文档可以像代码一样进行 diff、branch、merge 等 Git 操作。目前已发布在 Data Company 开发平台，并在 Hacker News 上引起关注。
items.summary_en:
Noted. Processing complete.

***

**Startup's internal docs: bringing Git-like version control to Markdown for humans and agents.** The tool auto-generates professional site websites, with each page generated through versioned transformation (version, transform) operations. The process exposes files to the web via API endpoints built using Next.js server actions, and it has a basic agent protocol demonstrating how AI can document journey maps for you. Only 1 point, no comments yet suggesting it may be new submission.

items.title: Show HN: Full-self browsing - agents can drive any web task using this CLI Skill
items.summary: 文章介绍了名为 Full-self browsing 的 CLI Skill，它能让 AI 代理自主驱动任意网页任务。该工具通过命令行接口实现全自动化浏览器操作，无需人工干预即可完成复杂网页交互。项目已在 webcli.sh 上线，目前获得 1 个 HN 点，尚无评论。
items.summary_en: A CLI tool called WebCLI enables fully autonomous browser agents capable of independently executing complex web tasks without manual intervention. It operates as a CLI skill that converts browser control into programmable commands for AI agents. The project is shared via webcli.sh with early-stage community feedback on Hacker News.

items.title: Anthropic’s safety warnings may have just backfired — the government has pulled the plug on its most powerful AI
items.summary: Anthropic 近日在博客中公开表达不满，反对政府因一个狭窄的潜在越狱风险就召回其已部署给数亿用户的商业大模型。该公司强调，这一决定缺乏合理依据，认为安全风险不足以成为暂停大规模商用 AI 服务的理由。这场争议凸显了 AI 安全警告在实际政策响应中的反噬效应。
items.summary_en: Anthropic disputed the government's decision to recall one of its commercial AI models, arguing that a narrow potential jailbreak finding should not justify pulling a model deployed to hundreds of millions of users. The company expressed frustration in a blog post, stating it disagrees with the rationale for the action despite reported safety warnings surrounding the recalled model.

items.title: How I Built a 24 Game Solver: Brute-Force Meets Elegance in TypeScript
items.summary: 作者为解决“24点”数学谜题平台开发了一个 TypeScript 求解器：通过穷举四个数字的所有排列（最多24种）、4³=64种运算符组合及5种括号结构（对应卡特兰数C₃），共评估7,680种表达式；使用递归生成去重排列，并在计算过程中对浮点误差采用0.0001容差（如 `Math.abs(r3 - 24) < 0.0001`）确保分数类解（如8/(3−8/3)=24）能被正确识别。该算法通过短路除零和无效结果优化性能，最终可返回所有有效解。
items.summary_en: Built a complete 24 Game solver in TypeScript using a brute-force combinatorics approach, evaluating all 7,680 possibilities (24 permutations × 64 operator combinations × 5 parenthesization patterns derived from Catalan number C₃). The algorithm handles duplicate numbers via deduplicated permutations, checks all five binary tree expression structures, and solves floating-point precision issues by comparing `Math.abs(result - 24) < 0.0001`. Deployed on a math puzzle platform as a production tool.

items.title: maziyarpanahi/openmed
items.summary: maziyarpanahi/openmed 是一款开源、本地优先的医疗 AI 工具，提供超过 1,000 个生物医学与临床模型，支持 12 种语言和 247 个 PII 检查点，可在设备端（包括 Apple Silicon 上的 MLX 加速和 iOS/macOS 原生应用）完全离线运行，无需云端或 API 密钥。它通过一行 Python 代码即可实现临床文本的实体提取、PII 去标识化等任务，在 Apple Silicon 上比 CPU PyTorch 快 24–33 倍，并采用 Apache-2.0 许可，确保无厂商锁定、患者数据不出网络。
items.summary_en: OpenMed is an open-source, on-device healthcare AI library offering 1,000+ specialized medical models for clinical entity extraction and PII de-identification across 12 languages, all running locally on-device with zero data leaving the user's network. It supports Apple Silicon via MLX acceleration for up to 33× faster inference than CPU, works natively on iOS/macOS through OpenMedKit, and can be deployed in one line of Python or via Docker, licensed under Apache-2.0. Core capabilities include HIPAA-compliant redaction of all 18 Safe Harbor identifiers, format-preserving fake replacement, and offline operation even in air-gapped environments.

items.title: 早报｜SpaceX上市首日暴涨/苹果高管：Siri不想做用户的情感伴侣/华为余承东：要带盘古大模型从中国第一走向世界第一
items.summary: SpaceX 上市首日收涨 19%，市值升至 2.1 万亿美元，募资 750 亿美元创美股史上最大 IPO 纪录，马斯克成为全球首位万亿富豪。华为余承东在 HDC 2026 上宣布亲自带队将盘古大模型从中国第一推向世界第一，同时鸿蒙 6 终端设备数突破 6600 万，星闪协议栈将于 7 月 15 日全量开源。小米 MiMo Code 由 5 人用 14 天 vibe-coding 完成开发，Kimi K2.7 Code 开源使长程编程任务 token 消耗减少 30%，Genspark 获 1 亿美元 B 轮追加融资、估值达 26 亿美元。
items.summary_en: SpaceX launched its IPO on Nasdaq at $135 per share, raising $75 billion—the largest in history—and surged 19% on day one, reaching a $2.1 trillion valuation and making Elon Musk the world's first trillionaire. Huawei's Yu Chengdong vowed to take its PanGu LLM from China's top spot to the world's #1, announcing HarmonyOS 7 Beta alongside growth stats including 66M HarmonyOS 6 devices. DJI sued Insta360 over Luna gimbal-camera patents, prompting a countersuit covering 5 stabilization and control patents; Meituan's Codex added a "save reset" feature for paid users; Xiaomi's MiMo Code was built by 5 people in 14 days via vibe-coding; and Genspark raised an additional $100M Series B at a $2.6B valuation.

items.title: apple/container
items.summary: container 是 Apple 用 Swift 编写的开源工具，专为 Apple silicon Mac 优化，通过轻量级虚拟机运行 Linux 容器。该工具兼容 OCI 标准镜像格式，可与任意标准容器注册表交互拉取和推送镜像，底层依赖 Containerization Swift package 进行容器、镜像和进程管理。目前仅支持 macOS 26，需 Apple silicon 芯片，项目处于活跃开发阶段，1.0.0 之前的小版本更新可能包含破坏性变更。
items.summary_en: container is a Swift-based tool for running Linux containers as lightweight VMs on Apple silicon Macs, producing and consuming OCI-compatible images. It supports macOS 26 exclusively, relying on its enhanced virtualization and networking features, and is installed via signed package from GitHub releases. The tool is in active development with breaking changes possible between minor versions until 1.0.0.

items.title: LMCache/LMCache
items.summary: LMCache 是一个专为 LLM 推理设计的 KV 缓存管理层，通过将 KV 缓存从临时状态转变为可复用的 AI 原生知识，显著降低 TTFT 并提升吞吐量，尤其适用于长上下文智能体、多轮对话和 RAG 等工作负载。该工具支持跨 CPU 内存、SSD、Redis/Valkey、S3 兼容对象存储等多级缓存层的持久化卸载与复用，并提供引擎独立的守护进程部署（即使推理引擎崩溃也不会丢失缓存），以及细粒度的 KV 缓存可观测性指标。LMCache 已被集成至 vLLM、NVIDIA Dynamo、CoreWeave 及 PyTorch Foundation 生态中，于 2025 年获得 5000+ GitHub stars，并为 gpt-oss（20B/120B）提供首日支持，实现对 AMD、Arm、Ascend 等多硬件的无厂商绑定兼容。
items.summary_en: LMCache is a vendor-neutral, engine-independent KV cache management layer for LLM inference that stores caches persistently across tiered storage (CPU memory, local SSD, Redis, S3-compatible, etc.), enabling reuse across requests, sessions, and serving instances to reduce TTFT and boost throughput for long-context, multi-turn, and RAG workloads. Key features include non-prefix KV reuse via CacheBlend, PD disaggregation with KV transfer over NVLink/RDMA/TCP (NIXL), pluggable storage and SERDE transformation backends, and production-level observability metrics; it has been integrated with NVIDIA Dynamo, vLLM V1, and CoreWeave for Cohere inference, and surpassed 5,000 GitHub stars.

directions.name: LocalAgent Starter Kit
directions.description: 一键式本地 AI 编程助手部署工具，专为 macOS 用户设计，集成 Ollama、VS Code 和 Continue 插件的自动化配置向导。
directions.target_user: 独立开发者和一人公司创业者，希望在本地运行 AI 编程助手以保护数据隐私并避免 API 费用。
core_features: 一键安装 Ollama 和推荐模型（如 codellama 7B）
自动配置 VS Code 和 Continue 插件
提供模型参数优化建议，适配不同硬件配置
directions.why_now: Hacker News 上关于本地编码 Agent 的讨论热度持续上升，用户对数据隐私和避免云端 API 费用的需求日益增长。文章提到本地部署可避免网络延迟和使用次数限制，但配置过程复杂，存在明显痛点。
directions.monetization: 免费基础版 + 付费高级功能（如多模型管理、性能优化建议）
directions.source_article: Hermes Agent 在 OpenRouter 上的使用指南：设置、模型与路由
